results.name: FM-15 selection toolbar: click, Shift-range, Ctrl-toggle, Ctrl+A, Esc; count and size equal the server's sizes; batch trash then batch restore from Trash
FM-02 + FM-03 dual pane: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V across panes copies byte-identically, a second paste picks conflict-free names, Ctrl+X moves, F5 copies to the other pane
FM-02 drag and drop: a row dragged onto the other pane moves it, Ctrl-drag copies, a row dropped on a folder row moves it into that folder (server-verified)
SH-09 history: double-click in, breadcrumbs, Back / Forward buttons, Alt+← / Alt+→, Backspace, mouse buttons 4 / 5 navigate the pane and never the browser tab; a new navigation clears Forward
FM-01 folder tree + column view + tabs: the tree lists the server's folders and navigates; Columns show every ancestor; tabs keep their own folder
FM-06 context menu: concise vs full sets, type-to-search reaches any action, arrow keys + Enter run it, Esc closes; background menu has New / templates / Paste
FM-13 New from template: the menu lists /System/Templates from the server; a new file is a byte copy of the template; a second one gets a free name
FM-16 quick filter + Subfolders: deep matches equal a recursive walk of the server; % and _ are literal; dotfiles and /System stay out
FM-17 folder sizes: every folder row shows the size of its subtree (= a recursive walk of the server), and the cached size refreshes after a write
FM-09 / DP-03 origin badges: rows say where bytes live; offline, a new file shows as a 'queued' ghost row and becomes a real server row after replay
FM-15 keyboard file operations: F2 renames, Delete trashes, Shift-range compress builds one archive (zipfile-verified), selection batch rename touches only the selection
FM-02 terminal pane: the real Terminal docks under the panes, follows the active pane's folder, and runs commands there
regressions: one roving tab stop in the listing, one file input, Space selects / Enter opens, axe finds no serious violations in the new chrome (tabs, toolbar, menu, tree)
